data_source: NASA Exoplanet Archive cumulative KOI table (real disposition + real false-positive-reason flags) + real Kepler long-cadence light curves via lightkurve/MAST. No synthetic light curves in this training set.
known_gaps: Centroid branch honestly zeroed/absent for every sample (no real Kepler TPF centroid ingestion in this pass). Metadata vector uses only real koi_steff/koi_srad/koi_depth; no 2MASS/Pan-STARRS/RUWE cross-match attempted for these Kepler stars, so those fields are honestly absent (presence=0), not fabricated.
